title: Boundary wall maximum length, R30-R40 narrow lots with rear right-of-way access (80%)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, R30 - R40 where frontage is 8.5m or less and access is taken from a rear right of way: maximum boundary wall length 80% of the length of the lot boundary the wall abuts, excluding any portion of the lot boundary which abuts an adjoining private open space.

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

replaces.note: no narrow-lot row in Part C (C4P1-094)

verified.note: Values clear on the page. 'Adjoining private open space' is not defined for this test; that is a definitional gap, not a page ambiguity.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#length-r30-r40-narrow. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. 80% of the abutted boundary excluding any portion abutting adjoining private open space; that exclusion is undefined for the deemed exempt test.
